name: Floyd Prozanski

bio.statement: In his pamphlet statement, Prozanski lists his occupations as State Senator and municipal prosecutor, with a background as legislator, assistant district attorney and laborer.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: State Senator; Municipal Prosecutor Occupational Background: Legislator; Assistant District Attorney; Laborer

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 37

bio.statement: Prozanski lists prior governmental experience including the Oregon Senate, Oregon House, Lane County Assistant District Attorney, Eugene Police Commission and Oregon Law Commission.
bio.excerpt: Prior Governmental Experience: Oregon Senate; Oregon House of Representatives; Lane County Assistant District Attorney; Eugene Police Commission; Oregon Law Commission

source.publisher: Oregon Voters' Pamphlet 2026 General, Lane edition (Book 4), p. 37

bio.statement: Prozanski's official legislative page says he is the state senator representing District 4, covering Eugene and Springfield.
bio.excerpt: I am honored to serve as the state senator representing District 4, an urban-rural district

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Senator Floyd Prozanski home page

bio.statement: Prozanski's official biography says he was appointed to represent Oregon Senate District 4 in 2003 and was first elected to the Legislature in 1994.
bio.excerpt: Floyd was appointed to represent Oregon Senate District 4 in 2003.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Senator Floyd Prozanski biography
